title: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: Pengantar fundamental Machine Learning: pergeseran paradigma dari sistem berbasis aturan, taksonomi Supervised, Unsupervised, dan Reinforcement Learning, struktur fitur dan label, siklus pelatihan, validasi, pengujian, generalisasi, Bias–Variance Trade-off, peran krusial baseline model, pencegahan data leakage, serta etika Responsible ML.
objectives: Menjelaskan konsep Machine Learning dan perbedaannya dengan Rule-Based Systems.
Mengidentifikasi Supervised, Unsupervised, dan Reinforcement Learning.
Menjelaskan features, labels, samples, models, dan predictions.
Menjelaskan Training, Validation, Testing, dan Inference.
Menjelaskan peran baseline dalam evaluasi model.
Menginterpretasikan hasil model sederhana tanpa membuat klaim berlebihan.

references.title: Russell, S., & Norvig, P. (2020). Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (4th ed.). Pearson.
Mitchell, T. M. (1997). Machine Learning. McGraw-Hill.
Hastie, T., Tibshirani, R., & Friedman, J. (2009). The Elements of Statistical Learning (2nd ed.). Springer.
Goodfellow, I., Bengio, Y., & Courville, A. (2016). Deep Learning. MIT Press.
ACM / IEEE-CS / AAAI. (2024). Computer Science Curricula 2023 (CS2023): AI Knowledge Area.
